spec.description: Load test comparison dashboard for OTel Operator K8s Events receiver configurations. Tracks resource consumption, pipeline throughput, error rates, and queue pressure across test scenarios.

spec.title: Memory Working Set
spec.description: Current memory working set from cAdvisor (OOM-kill threshold)

spec.title: Log Records / sec (Exported)
spec.description: Current rate of successfully exported log records

spec.title: Total Errors
spec.description: Sum of refused + failed + dropped log records

spec.title: Refused / Failed / Dropped Log Records (rate)
spec.description:
Stacked bar chart of error categories. In a healthy test, these should all be zero.

• Orange = Receiver refused (backpressure)
• Red = Exporter send failed
• Purple = Processor dropped

spec.title: Error Summary Table
spec.description: Cumulative count of refused, failed, and dropped log records over the selected time range. All values should be 0 in a healthy test.

spec.title: Exporter Queue Size vs Capacity
spec.description: Current queue depth (solid lines) vs maximum queue capacity (dashed red lines). Spikes in queue size indicate the exporter can't keep up with the pipeline. If queue size approaches capacity, data loss is imminent.

spec.title: Exporter Queue Utilization (%)
spec.description: Queue size as a percentage of capacity. The red threshold zone at 80%+ highlights dangerous saturation. Sustained values above 80% indicate the exporter is a bottleneck.

spec.title: CPU Usage (cAdvisor)
spec.description: Container CPU usage rate from cAdvisor — this is what K8s uses for resource limits/requests. One series per pod/container.

spec.title: Memory Working Set (cAdvisor)
spec.description: Container memory working set from cAdvisor — this is the value K8s uses for OOM kill decisions. One series per pod/container.

spec.title: Process CPU (Collector Self-Report)
spec.description: CPU time reported by the OTel Collector process itself via :8888/metrics. Useful for cross-checking against cAdvisor values. Dashed lines to visually distinguish from the primary cAdvisor panels.

spec.title: Process RSS Memory (Collector Self-Report)
spec.description: RSS memory reported by the OTel Collector process itself via :8888/metrics. Useful for cross-checking against cAdvisor values. Dashed lines to visually distinguish from the primary cAdvisor panels.

spec.title: Log Records Received (rate)
spec.description: Rate of log records accepted by the receiver — confirms both test setups process the same input volume. Breakdown by pod and receiver.

spec.title: Log Records Exported (rate)
spec.description: Rate of log records successfully exported — end-to-end throughput. Breakdown by pod and exporter.

spec.title: Resource Consumption — OTel Collector Process Metrics (Sanity Check)
